plugin.name: Splinter Cell Essentials PPSSPP Fusion Fix
SkipIntro.description: Skip the loader’s first movie; its required second movie remains intact. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
StickDeadzone.description: Set the deadzone for both analog sticks. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
SpeedStickControl.description: Use the left stick to control movement speed. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
Enable60FPS.description: Use native elapsed-time simulation with the main-loop 60 FPS limiter. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
UnthrottleEmuDuringLoading.description: Unthrottle during loading. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
FOVFactor.description: Scale gameplay FOV; device close-ups keep their native overlay framing. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
ContainFullscreenImages.description: Keep loading pictures, briefing screens and subtitled movies at their native aspect with side bars. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
HudScale.description: Scale the HUD inside its aspect-correct canvas. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
